title: UX RTL Structure Compiler
description: Validates RTL structure specs: layout mirroring, navigation direction reversal, icon directionality variants, text alignment overrides, responsive compatibility, and contract attestation. Produces rtl-structure-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract rtl-spec.json from feature brief and element definitions

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate spec shape and required fields

pipeline.title: Mirroring
pipeline.description: Validate layout mirroring, navigation reversal, and icon directionality

pipeline.title: Text
pipeline.description: Validate text alignment overrides and responsive compatibility

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: rtl-spec.json exists with locales(array), elements(array); each element has id+type+currentDirection

gates.title: Layouts Flipped
gates.description: Every element with type=layout and currentDirection=ltr must declare rtlMirror:true or rtlOverride object

gates.title: Navigation Reversed
gates.description: If spec has navigation, it must declare rtlReverseDirection:true and rtlBackIcon; escape hatch: directionNeutral:true

gates.title: Icon Directionality
gates.description: Every element with type=icon and directional:true must declare rtlVariant(string)

gates.title: Text Alignment
gates.description: Every element with type=text and textAlign=left must declare rtlTextAlign: right or start

gates.title: Responsive Compatible
gates.description: If responsiveSpecRef exists, validates no fixed directional overrides without RTL declarations; escape hatch: responsiveCompatibilityExempt:true

gates.title: RTL Structure Contract
gates.description: Version, unique element ids, at least one RTL locale, at least one element

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled RTL structure specs

error_codes.URT001: rtl-spec.json missing or invalid — locales(array), elements(array) with id+type+currentDirection required
error_codes.URT002: LTR layout element missing rtlMirror:true or rtlOverride declaration
error_codes.URT003: Navigation missing rtlReverseDirection and rtlBackIcon — or directionNeutral:true
error_codes.URT005: Text element with textAlign=left missing rtlTextAlign override
error_codes.URT006: Responsive spec referenced but RTL compatibility not verified
error_codes.URT007: RTL structure contract violation — version, unique element ids, locales, or elements missing
